# IFN/OA response clean variant 2

ISG upregulation in IFN-treated OA chondrocytes was observed across the canonical ISG cluster. IFIT1 was upregulated (Table 2). ISG15 was upregulated (Table 2). OAS1 was upregulated (Table 2). IFIT3 was upregulated (Table 2). MX1 was upregulated (Table 2). OASL was upregulated (Table 2). ACAN was downregulated (Table 2). COL2A1 was downregulated (Table 2). GAPDH showed stable expression (Table 2).
